observation: Initial new-round E1 and E6 rolling/development scores return to epoch0; early rolling_A results for GRU and PatchTST show the same pattern. Bounded residuals alone do not remove unconditional drift.
hypothesis: Paired price reflection with shared backbone weights cancels the unconditional drift component, while retaining conditional momentum/reversal. This is a shape constraint, not a claim that market dynamics are perfectly symmetric.
budget: Six configurations times the same three scopes; same seed42, full eligible data, eight epochs maximum and patience2. No holdout evaluation.
gate: Use the unchanged registered mean MAE/MSE/block gate against its exact non-reflected control. Add each passing reflected model to the stage decision, then apply the original market-eligibility/ranking rule.
modal_implication: If a reflected market is selected, auxiliary branches multiply an input-window signed momentum context to avoid an unconditional auxiliary intercept. Compare the same context on all matching modal controls. Full contents versus retrained masks/coverage remain mandatory.
provenance: debias.py is immutable for these runs and its SHA256 is recorded in the source manifest before training. Original run.py and initial results are preserved.
final_test_policy: Unchanged: all stages, replication and final hashes fixed before one final holdout evaluation batch.
